name: Better Roundabouts
summary: Roundabouts, hamburger and Magic Roundabouts, channelized junctions and roundabout interchanges.
description: Configurable roundabouts: arms, radius, round or oval, mini sizes, splitter islands, a road or tram line through the centre (hamburger roundabouts with a wider road, experimental traffic lights), tram tracks, centre islands, plus a Magic Roundabout, a Channelized Junction with slip lanes and a Roundabout Interchange with a highway. Once built, everything is ordinary editable roads.
